Definition: Whether the government has established dedicated data center infrastructure and/or a government cloud (G-Cloud) strategy for hosting e-government services and public sector data domestically. Critical for data sovereignty and e-government service delivery.
Value Name: Government data center planned or under construction
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first.
revision_notes: Original row cited no source. Verified via MICT Strategic Plan 2025-2030 and MICT 2025/26 Budget Speech (Namibian dollars, current), which state groundwork on a National Data Centre would only commence in FY2025/26, plus a September 2025 Cabinet briefing (Min. Theofelus) confirming MICT and the PM's Office were still finalising the concept note/project proposal, and a November 2025 CRAN statement that the government data centre was still at the planning stage (only one existing Tier 3 facility, privately/CRAN/Home Affairs operated, not a national G-Cloud). No operational national government data centre exists. Value Code 2 (planned/under construction) is confirmed by these sources; score unchanged.
